encounter: E0458 TRAINER_ARCHIE, Seafloor Cavern Aqua leader, cap 84 doubles - attempt 2 rebuild
availability_audit: Cap window 84. Seafloor Cavern via Dive from Route 128 after the Space Center; Sootopolis not entered, Kyogre not awakened. Flutter Mane 68 (wild MtPyre_Summit), Iron Bundle 60 (wild ShoalCave_LowTideIceRoom), Incineroar 36 (Torracat evolution), Rillaboom 36 (Thwackey evolution), Zapdos 30 (legendary_sign NewMauville_Inside, reachable legend), Landorus 42 (legendary_sign Route111_RuinsExterior, reachable legend). Rebuilt after attempt 1 (lost 2-6): Torkoal's sun was undone by Pelipper re-entry, Seismitoad's Earth Power OHKOed Torkoal, Kartana and Raging Bolt, and Muk's Gunk Shot OHKOed Rillaboom and Amoonguss.
plan: Freeze-Dry is 4x on both Pelipper and Seismitoad and 2x on Sharpedo and Dhelmise, so Iron Bundle is the honest answer to the rain half; Flutter Mane leads beside it because Fake Out and Anchor Shot's trap do nothing to a Ghost. Zapdos and Landorus are immune to Seismitoad's Earth Power and cover Muk/Toxicroak (Earth Power 2x, Psychic 4x on Toxicroak). Incineroar's Intimidate blunts four physical attackers and Fake Out buys turns; Rillaboom's Grassy Glide is the priority 4x on Seismitoad.
